item.title: Leveling Up lvl 1
item.description: Blast - Build - Battle. Motto of the U.S. 16th Engineer Brigade My day started slow, turned off the alarm, then initiated bathroom/hygiene protocol. today was somewhat wasted. I watched youtube videos from which i gained extra passion for IT. I pondered some scenarios in mind to manage my home-lab. I got distraced by biology and desires. I ain’t no Sheldon Cooper. But hey, life is full of rises and falls.

item.title: Reborn as Dr. Mordor
item.description: I’ve had my ups and downs, my fair share of bumpy roads and heavy winds. thats what made me what I am today.Van damme In a warm summer evening I got fed up by my procrastination and lack of progress in life. This was a month ago when the wake up call hit me. I needed to wake up and focus on my what am I doing in my life, building my career.
